custom_instruments.manage.Holiday

A holiday returned by the holidays request.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.Holiday.

Syntax

Holiday(date: OptDateTime = None, name: str = None, holiday: dict = None, tag: str = '')

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
date OptDateTime No None Date of the holiday. If omitted, the date is taken from holiday.
name str No None Name of the holiday. Ignored when holiday contains names.
holiday dict No None Holiday item of the 'holidays' response.
tag str No '' Tag of the request item the holiday belongs to.

Properties

Property Description
calendars Calendars in which the holiday applies.
countries Countries in which the holiday applies.
date Date of the holiday.
names Names of the holiday, with the calendars and countries each name applies to.
tag Tag of the request item the holiday belongs to.
